answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 45 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a mirror bet on surviving 45 epochs of grading, and every thread settlement recomputes the echo schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 16 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 35 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
